title: Candoshi-Shapra language - Wikipedia
text: Candoshi-Shapra is an indigenous American language isolate, spoken by several thousand people in western South America along the Chapuli, Huitoyacu, Pastaza, and Morona river valleys. There are two dialects, Chapara and Kandoashi.

title: Kandozi-Chapra in Peru people group profile | Joshua Project
text: The Kandozi-Chapra people speak Kandozi-Chapra, a language isolate not closely related to any other living language. They reside in the northern Peruvian Amazon along the tributaries of the Pastaza and Morona rivers in the Loreto region.
